ai.overview: This marks the Knicks' first defense of their current belt reign, while the Bulls have held the belt 102 times previously in the title's history. With 26 prior meetings for the belt, both teams know what's at stake in this storied rivalry.
key_matchups: Knicks looking to build on 111–97 win over Detroit while Bulls reel from 99–134 loss at Boston
Chicago's defensive struggles evident in recent games: 134, 124, and 135 points allowed in last three

The Bulls have surrendered 134, 124, 135, and 149 points in four of their last five games, signaling major defensive issues. The Elo model strongly favors New York despite the Bulls holding a 155-134 edge in the all-time series.
ai.prediction_writeup: The Knicks have won their last 1 game and appear to be finding form after a rough start, while the Bulls have lost their last 2 games with alarming defensive breakdowns. Chicago allowed 134 points to Boston in their most recent outing and has been hemorrhaging points throughout their last five games. New York dominated the most recent meeting 136-96 and should capitalize on Chicago's defensive vulnerabilities. The Elo model's clear favoritism toward the Knicks aligns with the recent form and head-to-head trends, making them the pick to defend the belt successfully for the first time in this reign.
